revise.title: Discover gifts and tours on a phone
revise.lead: Guests browse without an account: the home page suggests gifts and tours by how much time they have, and search finds any item.
callouts: Ideas by available time
Blocks such as 'Have 2 hours in Lucerne?' and 'A few days here?' lead into gifts, tours and stories.
Earliest pickup on cards
Each gift card shows its price and the earliest date it can be picked up, so guests can plan early.
Browse or search
Search finds gifts and tours together; with an empty box, category tiles such as Pocket knives open that range.
captions: Time-based ideas, tours, stories and gift rails
Filter by category; earliest pickup on each card
Gifts and tours in one list

revise.title: Choose a gift and make it personal
revise.lead: The gift page tells the story, then a choices sheet collects what the shop needs: size, quantity, engraving, pickup date and pickup place.
callouts: Size, quantity, engraving
On the knife, guests pick Small, Medium or Large and may add free engraving of up to 12 characters.
Pickup dates that make sense
Days the shop cannot prepare in time are greyed out with the reason, such as 'Needs 3 working days to engrave'.
Reviews from real buyers
Only guests who completed an order can review, and each review shows its purchase date.
captions: Size, quantity, engraving and pickup calendar

revise.title: Request your gifts, pay once accepted
revise.lead: A request is not a purchase: the guest sends the cart, the shop confirms each order, and only then does the guest pay within 24 hours.
revise.badge: The shop confirms first, then the guest pays within 24 hours
captions: Tick what to order; different dates become separate orders
Per order: pickup, amount due after confirmation, policy
Orders wait for the shop; nothing is charged
Payment page opens only after the shop accepts

revise.title: Track every order and booking
revise.lead: The Account tab is the guest's home for everything bought: orders, tour bookings, payments due and the history of each status change.
callouts: Status and payment apart
Each order shows two labels, such as 'Accepted' and 'Payment due', so progress and money never get mixed up.
Pay the balance later
After a deposit, 'Pay CHF 62.30' stays on the order, even after the shop hands the gift over.
Review after completion
The 'Write a review' button appears only once the shop has marked the order completed.
captions: Status, payment and pickup in one place
Tour booking with its own payment status

new.title: From pickup choice to a checked cart
new.lead: Guests set a pickup date and place, get instant feedback when a gift is added, and can check the price or remove items safely in the cart.
new.badge: Pickup dates are requests until the shop confirms
phones: Pale days show why; Shop Altstadt or Bahnhof pickup point
Bottom bar and cart badge confirm the add
Each item and date; total is only for reference
A dialog names the item and its price

new.title: Sign in only when sending a request
new.lead: Guests browse and fill a cart without an account; signing in is asked for only when they press Continue, using Google or a code sent by email.
new.badge: Google and email codes are simulated in this prototype
phones: No password; the cart stays untouched
Six digits, valid for 10 minutes, resend after 30 seconds
The mock mailbox stands in for real email
Second order: 30% deposit due after confirmation

new.title: After acceptance: pay, retry or wait
new.lead: Once the shop accepts, the guest gets an email with the amount and a 24-hour deadline, and the payment page ends in success, a decline or a wait.
phones: Amount, pay-by time and auto-cancel rule
No money taken; Try again reopens payment
'Please don't pay again' until the provider answers
callouts: Email states the deadline
The acceptance email names the amount, the date and time to pay by, and warns about automatic cancellation.
A decline loses nothing
If the payment is declined, no money is taken and the guest can try again on the same page.
No double payments
While the provider has not answered, the order shows Payment processing and hides the Pay button.

new.title: Missed the 24 hours? Request again
new.lead: If the first payment is late, the order cancels itself after 24 hours, and the guest can put the gifts back in the cart.
phones: The guest's other orders are not affected
Gifts return to the cart for a new date
callouts: Automatic cancellation
The order shows Cancelled, payment overdue, nothing is charged, and the stock held for it is released.
Request again
One tap puts the gifts back in the cart; nothing is sent until the guest picks a date and sends.
Dates are re-checked
The cart flags a date that no longer works and offers the next valid one, such as Mon 19 Oct.

new.title: One order, four tabs
new.lead: Each order page keeps the answers a guest needs: where and when to collect, what is paid, what happened so far, and the agreed terms.
new.badge: Example: gift box with the 30% deposit paid
phones: Pickup date, place and opening hours
Total, paid and still to pay
Request, acceptance, payment, then next steps
Terms as at ordering; later changes do not apply

new.title: Pay the rest, collect, then review
new.lead: After handover a deposit order's balance can still be paid online, and once an order is complete the guest may rate the gift.
new.badge: Reviews open only after the order is completed
phones: Pay the rest online or at the shop
Knife order: paid in full, review button
Shown on the gift with its purchase date

new.lead: The account lists orders, payments due and emails, and the whole interface can switch to German with Swiss dates and CHF amounts.
new.badge: Same screen in English and German
